cc:Work.dc:description: Illustrative 20 s repetition. Baseline C=60 kJ/K and G=0.5 kW/K has run10 / periodic peaks 51.418 / 57.569 C. Doubling capacity alone gives 42.679 / 56.267 C; doubling conductance alone gives 42.009 / 42.639 C. Every run deposits 300 kJ; ambient is 25 C. Increasing C mostly buys transient thermal buffer; it does not replace sufficient heat rejection.
